name: Cupcake Kerfuffle
author: Addicting Games
description: Cupcake Kerfuffle is a free management game. Everybody has dreamed about starting their own business. Thrills and chills of franchise management and the adrenaline-pumping joy that comes from baking, icing, and serving cupcakes to customers are truly second to none. In Cupcake Kerfuffle you will take command of a cute little bakery and it is your job to take customers' orders, make the correct cupcake, ice it just the way they want, serve it to the customer, and then collect their money. You must do this in an orderly and timely manner if you wish to optimize the amount of money you make and grow your business. Pay attention to the long line of customers and be sure to get everyone the correct order in the allotted time or they won't pay and they'll be unhappy. This is a fun game that offers you but a taste of the real-world, of a job, of responsibility, and of the delicate but satisfying pressure to perform a task and doing it properly. Be timely and be smart in this fun resource management style game.
